scripts.build: npm run cinematic:prepare && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:level1: npm run cinematic:prepare && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode level1 --outDir dist-level1
scripts.build:level2: npm run cinematic:prepare && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode level2 --outDir dist-level2
scripts.build:level3: npm run cinematic:prepare && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode level3 --outDir dist-level3
scripts.build:previews: npm run cinematic:prepare && npm run check && vite build && vite build --mode level1 --outDir dist-level1 && vite build --mode level2 --outDir dist-level2 && vite build --mode level3 --outDir dist-level3
scripts.cinematic:prepare: node scripts/level1-film.mjs && node scripts/level2-film.mjs && node scripts/level3-film.mjs && node scripts/ending-film.mjs
scripts.lab:build: npm run lab:check && vite build --config design-lab/vite.config.ts
